{{short description|Organization for research on Fibonacci numbers}}
The '''Fibonacci Association''' is a mathematical organization that specializes in the [[Fibonacci number]] sequence and related topics in mathematics.<ref name=howard>{{citation
 | last = Howard | first = Fredric T.
 | date = February 2005
 | doi = 10.1080/10724117.2005.12021808
 | issue = 3
 | journal = Math Horizons
 | page = 31
 | title = The Fibonacci Association
 | volume = 12}}</ref>

==History==
The organization was founded in 1963 by Brother [[Alfred Brousseau]] FSC of [[Saint Mary's College of California]] and [[Verner Emil Hoggatt. Jr|Verner E. Hoggatt Jr.]] of San Jose State College (now San Jose State University), together with Stanley L. Basin, Terrance A. Brennan, {{ill|Paul F. Byrd|de}}, and I. Dale Ruggles.<ref name=bicknell>{{citation
 | last = Bicknell-Johnson | first = Marjorie
 | journal = Fibonacci Quarterly
 | pages = 2–5
 | title = A short history of ''The Fibonacci Quarterly''
 | url = https://www.fq.math.ca/Scanned/25-1/bicknell.pdf
 | volume = 25
 | year = 1987| doi = 10.1080/00150517.1987.12429719
 }}</ref>

==Publications==
Since the year of its founding, the Fibonacci Association has published an international [[mathematical journal]], The ''[[Fibonacci Quarterly]]''.<ref name=howard/><ref name=bicknell/>

The Fibonacci Association also publishes proceedings for [[International Conference on Fibonacci Numbers and their Applications|its international conferences]], held every two years since 1984.<ref name=howard/>
